neighbours.label: ' more' in the comparative phrase 'is more likely' (weak; the pole only reaches about 0.2 of its max on it)
fire: Of the three explanations, the first is more likely to be true.
Rain is more likely in the afternoon than in the morning.
I wonder which of these two results is more likely.
A draw is more likely than a win for either side.
Given the evidence, the simpler theory is more likely.
Older engines are more likely to overheat in summer.
Tell me which of the two paths is more likely to flood.
In small samples an extreme value is more likely to appear.
quiet: Of the three explanations, the first is likely to be true.
Rain is likely in the afternoon and in the morning.
I wonder which of these two results is correct.
A draw is as likely as a win for either side.
Given the evidence, the simpler theory is probably right.

Tell me which of the two paths is likely to flood.
In small samples an extreme value is likely to appear.
